title: Where Do Private Boat Trips Leave From in Funchal, and How to Get There?
description: Private boat trips leave from Marina do Funchal, mid-seafront beside Avenida do Mar. Walk, take a taxi or a bus, and be on the pontoon 15 minutes early.
